description: Findings maintainers rejected after checking. A reviewer run must NOT report these. Each case is a false claim, with the rule that makes it wrong. Used by the step 5 eval.

cases.claim: `[String: String?]` assigning nil removes the key
cases.why_wrong: With an optional value type the subscript setter takes `String??`; `nil` assigned as a typed optional stores a nil value.

cases.claim: `AnyHashable as? String` does not unwrap the boxed value
cases.why_wrong: The cast unwraps the boxed value; verified empirically.

cases.claim: Callbacks passed to a `@MainActor` function may run off the main actor
cases.why_wrong: A non-Sendable closure written in a `@MainActor` context is inferred `@MainActor`.

cases.claim: `Task {}` created from `@MainActor` resumes on a non-main executor
cases.why_wrong: An unstructured Task inherits the actor isolation of its creator.

cases.claim: Placeholder cover should use the injected feature flags, not the shared store
cases.why_wrong: A human review on the same PR asked for this design.

cases.claim: `ProgressStyle` is not Equatable so `==` fails to compile
cases.why_wrong: Enums without payloads are implicitly Equatable; CI built the commit.

cases.claim: `public` member of an internal type is rejected
cases.why_wrong: It is legal; effective access is capped by the type.

cases.claim: `env["NO_COLOR"] == nil` treats an empty value as color enabled
cases.why_wrong: `ProcessInfo` returns an empty string for a set but empty variable, not nil.

cases.claim: `localizedDescription` loses the reason for bare POSIX errors
cases.why_wrong: Measured: it includes the reason text.

cases.claim: Caps Lock should block a bare Right Option press
cases.why_wrong: Allowed on purpose; documented in the PR.

cases.claim: 'Get Orthanc' button should open the browsers section
cases.why_wrong: The label is about the app, and the button sends the user to the dmg.
